display_long_description:
🚀 Step into space with VR Schoool: Solar System, a free interactive experience designed for those who love exploring and learning through Virtual Reality.

🌌 Fly among the planets, orbit the Sun, and discover fascinating facts about our cosmic neighborhood like never before. See the planets in stunning 3D detail, understand their unique features, and explore moons, rings, and asteroids up close.

🌍 Key Features:
• 🪐 Explore all planets of the Solar System in full 3D
• 🎧 English and Spanish narration for a fully guided experience
• 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Designed for families, students, and science enthusiasts
• 🎶 Relaxing music and immersive voice-over for an educational atmosphere
• 🌟 Interactive learning: discover facts about gravity, orbits, and space exploration


📚 Part of the VR Schoool Series — bringing science, space, and exploration to life through Virtual Reality.

🌠 Continue your journey with Leonardo da Vinci and The Dinosaurs, also available on the Meta Store.

🚀 And stay tuned! Many more VR Schoool lessons are currently in development.
